0-1.title: Rooftop Dash
0-1.desc: A short practice run over the Unjongga rooftops. Human form from the start.

tips.grapple: See a lantern? Press K or Right Click to hook it and swing. Release with Space to launch.
tips.grapple_touch: Jump near a lantern and tap "Jump" again — when the button turns to "Hook", you're hooked. Tap "Jump" while swinging to launch.
tips.crumble: Cracked tiles cave in fast. Don't stop on them.
